description: Curated one-line summaries from the captured 2026-09-24 Notion MCP manifest. Descriptions are curated from the captured manifest.
provenance: Description curated from the captured 2026-09-24 Notion MCP manifest and current Notion MCP supported-tools docs.

cards.summary: Search Notion and connected sources such as Slack or Mail when AI search is available, including keywords. Not a fetch by URL and not a row query.
Call at most once, and only when a fetch result asks for MCP next steps after the other calls finish. Not a search, fetch, or query.
Mark an existing workspace page as a skill without changing its content. Not a skill search and not a page rewrite.
Create one attachment from small UTF-8 text, a public HTTPS URL, or a finished upload. Not a local-file upload URL.
Add a comment to a page or a specific piece of its content. Does not read existing discussions.
Create a database with SQL DDL or a typed tasks, projects, or skills schema. Not a page and not a view on an existing database.
Create a short-lived URL so one local file can be posted directly to Notion. Does not create the page or the comment.
Create an empty Folder under a page or inside another Folder. Does not add pages or files.
Create one or more Notion pages, with properties and content. Not an update of an existing page.
Add a view, such as a board or calendar, to an existing database. Does not create the database or edit its rows.
Read the UTF-8 text of a small attachment by the upload id from create-attachment. Not a page fetch and not a binary file.
Download one Skill page as a tar.gz of SKILL.md and its supporting files. Not a skill search and not a page body fetch.
Copy one page inside the current workspace. The copy finishes asynchronously. Does not move the original.
Read one page, database, data source schema, or saved view settings by URL or ID. Not a row query and not a workspace search.
Read the status of an async task started by another tool, such as a page copy. Does not start or change that task.
Read comments and discussions on a page, including resolved threads when asked. Does not add a comment.
Read the latest turn status of a Custom Agent session without waiting. Does not start, stop, or message the session.
List workspace teamspaces with ids, names, and your membership. Not a page search and not a user directory.
Read this connection's tool availability, parameter restrictions, and upgrade links. Does not search, fetch, or change the workspace.
List workspace members and guests, or the current user, with ids and emails. Not a content search.
List the current user's pinned or favorite pages and databases in sidebar order. Not a content search.
List top-level pages and databases in the Private sidebar only. Does not open their contents.
List pages and databases the current user recently viewed, ranked by recency. Not a content search.
List short summaries of saved events in one Custom Agent session. Not the full event body and not a page search.
List pages and databases in the Shared sidebar only. Does not open their contents or search inside them.
Move one or more pages or databases to a new parent. Does not copy them or edit their content.
Read rows, run SQL, or return a saved view's rows for known data sources. Not a page-body fetch and not a workspace search.
Filter the current user's meeting-notes data source, including title keywords and action items. Not a general workspace search.
Run one read-only SQLite SQL query that combines multiple data sources. Not a page fetch and not a workspace content search.
List Custom Agent sessions you can access, with title filter or sort. Not page search and not excerpt search of past sessions.
Read the full visible content of one saved Custom Agent session event. Not a session list and not a Notion page fetch.
Keyword or filtered Notion workspace search when you have no URL or ID. Prefer AI search for connected Slack or Mail. Not a fetch or row query.
Search Custom Agents by name or description, or browse favorites and newest agents. Not page search and not session search.
Search past Custom Agent sessions by topic and return matching excerpts. Not a live session list and not Notion page search.
Find active Notion Skills by name or task. Returns skill metadata, not page bodies. Not a general workspace search.
Send a follow-up message to a Custom Agent session you can access. Does not start a new session.
Call once with no arguments when multi-source SQL needs the full Notion MCP. Not itself a query or a search.
Start a session with a published Custom Agent. Does not search past sessions or send a follow-up.
Stop a running Custom Agent session you can access. Does not delete the session or its events.
Change a data source schema, title, or attributes with SQL DDL, such as adding a property. Not a row query or a page edit.
Update an existing Folder, including adding files by upload id. Not a page body edit.
Update an existing page's properties or content. Not a new page and not a data-source schema change.
Change a view's name, filters, sorts, or display. Does not edit database rows or the data-source schema.
Import a Skill archive into a page in a Skills database. Not the flag that marks an existing page as a skill.
Wait until the latest turn in a Custom Agent session stops running. Does not send a message or start a session.
